_why: Mutant ids declared BEHAVIOUR-PRESERVING or UNREACHABLE for StructuralControl, each with the argument or the measurement behind it. `vit_mutate.py --equivalences` reads the KEYS of this object, so the claim and its reason live in one file. A declared mutant LEAVES THE DENOMINATOR, so every entry is a claim somebody has to be able to answer. FOUR are declared out of 55 mutants, and NONE of them is at a statement this unit's Fortran contains: all four are inside the two ErrMsg helpers COPIED VERBATIM from translations/ControllerBlocks/pitchsaturation.cpp (which took them from interp1d.cpp). Every mutant on this unit's own arithmetic, indexing, comparisons and control flow -- 51 of them, including all 5 arith_op, all 5 swap_operands, all 3 index_offset, all 7 negate_cond and 10 of 12 compare_op -- was KILLED by the 1263-case corpus.
_not_declared: SEVEN SURVIVORS OF THE FIRST SWEEP ARE ABSENT FROM THIS FILE AND WERE NOT EXCUSED. Four of them -- `cols > 0` -> `cols >= 0`, `cols > 0` -> `cols > 1`, `: 0` -> `: 1` and `j < cols` -> `j <= cols` -- were a DEFENSIVE GUARD this translation had and the reference does not, sizing the gather buffer against a quantity R5 never draws below 3, plus a length argument that hid a write past the buffer. The site was REWRITTEN (see the comment at it) rather than declared: the guard is dead code and the length is now `row.size()`, which is what the reference's `SIZE(yData)` denotes, so the loop-bound mutant now changes an observable length and dies. The other three -- the `StC_Mode == 2` loop's start index, the `Ind_StructControl(I_GROUP) > 0` widening and the row gather's own start index -- were UNREACHED rather than equivalent: R6 crosses `StC_Mode = 2` with `StC_Group_N = 1` but nothing makes `Ind_StructControl(1)` positive, because that subscript is the loop counter and the generator's own note says it is not traceable to a parameter. They are killed by harness/baseline.StructuralControl.json's first state, which ramps `Ind_StructControl` from exactly 1. Declaring any of the seven would have recorded a corpus gap, or a habit of mine, as a property of the mutants.
_measurement: evidence/StructuralControl/structuralcontrol.errmsg_census_probe.cpp is the shipped translation with counters and an atexit dump added and nothing else changed, run over all 1263 harness cases. The run is GREEN (HARNESS PASS: checked 1263 failed 0, evidence/StructuralControl/harness.errmsg_census.json), so it is a READING of the corpus and not a perturbation of it. evidence/StructuralControl/errmsg_census.txt: errmsg_trim 120 calls, assign_errmsg 120 calls; n_ErrMsg spans 8..17; n_ErrMsg_cap is 4104 in every one; longest message 35; n_ErrMsg == 1 zero times; n_ErrMsg <= 0 zero times; s.size() == n_ErrMsg_cap zero times; a trailing blank inside n_ErrMsg 3 times -- which is why the `find_last_not_of(' ') + 1` mutant at the same line is KILLED rather than declared here.
2b2ea093: compare_op '>' -> '>=' at `n > 0 ? static_cast<size_t>(n) : 0` in `errmsg_trim`. The two differ only at n == 0, where the tight form yields the literal 0 and the loose form yields static_cast<size_t>(0) -- the same length. EQUIVALENT ON EVERY VALUE THE C TYPE ADMITS, not merely on this corpus: interp1d's b61327db swept all 4,294,967,296 values of a 32-bit int at this identical line and reported 0 at which the view length differs (evidence/interp1d/equivalence_probe.cpp). This line is a character-for-character copy of that one -- see the header of translations/Controllers/structuralcontrol.cpp, which records the copy -- so the proof is the same proof, cited rather than re-run because re-running an exhaustive sweep over an identical expression measures the copy and not the claim. THE SEVENTH UNIT TO DECLARE THIS SITE.
3b32180d: const_tweak '0' -> '1' at one of the two literals of `n > 0 ? static_cast<size_t>(n) : 0`. Together with 6f654e4a below these are the `n > 1` form and the `: 1` form; the artifact records `before` and `after` and not which literal, so both are declared here and the pair is what the census answers. `n > 1` reads an ErrMsg arriving with LENGTH EXACTLY ONE as empty. UNREACHABLE ON THIS CORPUS AND MEASURED AS SUCH: n_ErrMsg == 1 in 0 of 120 calls, the observed range being 8..17. THE REASON IS A PROPERTY OF THE HARNESS RATHER THAN OF THIS UNIT: `_baseline_state` deliberately leaves every CHARACTER parameter to R6's own ladder (harness/generate.py:1107), so no state in harness/baseline.StructuralControl.json can move this length, and nothing in the generator puts this CHARACTER extent at 1. That is the same candidate corpus addition interp1d recorded in DECISIONS.md and did not take inside a unit -- a rung added to the character-length ladder shifts the random draws of every unit already scored, which is X3's question and not this unit's. NOT an equivalence: at n == 1 the two programs differ, and this declaration is a statement about the corpus.
6f654e4a: const_tweak '0' -> '1' at the other literal of the same line -- the pair of 3b32180d above. The `: 1` form reads an ErrMsg arriving with a NON-POSITIVE length as one byte instead of none. UNREACHABLE ON THIS CORPUS AND MEASURED: n_ErrMsg <= 0 in 0 of 120 calls. The 0 branch is the view's own NOT-ALLOCATED convention (VIT_CHAR_UNALLOCATED is -1 in vit_types.h) and the generator has no rung that puts a CHARACTER extent at its unallocated sentinel or at zero. Same site, same reason and same declaration as interp1d's 55e42d36, PitchSaturation's 3de6b9e0 and Shutdown's 42d008e1.
429b77c2: compare_op '>' -> '>=' at `if (static_cast<int>(s.size()) > ErrVar->n_ErrMsg_cap)` in `assign_errmsg`, the refusal guard. The two forms differ on exactly one input, s.size() == n_ErrMsg_cap. MEASURED: 0 of 120 assignments, against a capacity of 4104 in every call and a longest message of 35. THE SEVENTH UNIT TO DECLARE THIS SITE -- ReadAvrSWAP e82a5f90, ExtController 11d2c9cc, UpdateZeroMQ ac7a5b72, interp1d e34d5cc4, PitchSaturation 9fb5c514, Shutdown b4ef50f9 -- and the reason has not changed: the capacity is LEN(ErrMsg) + 4096 in the differential harness (harness/emit.py ALLOC_HEADROOM) and the same 4096 in the integrated build (vit_errorvariables_view.f90). R13_staging_capacity IS applied to this unit's corpus -- 256 cases sweeping the headroom from 0 to 255 -- and it still does not reach the boundary, because every one of those 256 cases takes its other inputs at the BASE DRAW, where ErrVar%aviFAIL is not negative and the refusal guard is never reached at all. The census says so from the value side: n_ErrMsg_cap is 4104 in all 120 calls that DO reach it. So the rule that exists to sweep this capacity and the arm that reads it are disjoint, and that is a finding about the instrument rather than about this translation -- unit #41 recorded it first and this unit reproduces it on a corpus an order of magnitude smaller.
